signInDialog.title: Sign in to generate
signInDialog.body: You need an account to build your page — it's free. Your prompt is saved, so you pick up right where you left off.

demoStrip.lenSays: Not sure where to start? Pick one and I'll fit it to your business.
demoStrip.title:
Hand-made designs.

Len makes them yours.
demoStrip.description: Your copy, your photos, your colors and your forms. You start with something beautiful and end with something yours.

analyticsLeads.lenSays: When someone writes to you, I'll let you know.
analyticsLeads.title: See who came by. <muted>And who wrote to you.</muted>
analyticsLeads.subtitle: Every page you publish comes with its own analytics and forms: how many people visit, where they come from and the messages in your inbox. No Google Analytics, no cookies, no consent banner.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.chartAria: Pageviews and visitors over the last 30 days

leads.title: Leads
leads.msg1: Interested in the team plan — can we book a quick call this week?
leads.msg2: Loved the page! Do you ship to Mexico, and what are the lead times?
leads.msg3: Quote request for 50 units — what volume pricing can you offer?
leads.emailNotice: Every submission is stored and emailed to you instantly

privacy.title: Privacy-first by default
privacy.body: No cookies, no consent banner, no IP storage. GDPR-clear — the same model as Plausible, but yours.

perLink.title: Per-link click tracking
perLink.body: See which links, buttons, and CTAs people actually click — not just page views.

inbox.title: Leads land in your inbox
inbox.body: Add a form to any page. Submissions are saved and emailed to you the moment they arrive.

coach.title: Page Coach
coach.tip: Move the WhatsApp button above the fold — 62% of visitors never scroll past the hero.
coach.body: Reads your funnel and tells you exactly what to fix — where visitors drop off and which change wins them back.

modules.title: Switch on chat. Ask for the rest.
modules.body: Chat becomes a section of your page with a real inbox behind it. Languages you pick when you publish. Your socials, your catalog, anything else — you ask, and it's written into the page, matching your brand.

trust.lenSays: Don't take my word for it: check.
trust.title: Everything we claim <muted>comes with a button to check it.</muted>
trust.subtitle: Uptime, speed and the code, in plain sight for anyone.

uptime.title: Live uptime
uptime.live: {pct} uptime — {window}, measured from the outside every 5 minutes
uptime.fallback: Public 24/7 monitoring — measured from the outside every 5 minutes

speed.title: Verifiable speed
speed.body: Born to score 100 on Lighthouse — delivered from 330+ cities, 95% of the planet under 50 ms.

yours.title: Truly yours
yours.body: Export your page to ZIP, GitHub or Vercel anytime — no lock-in. Encrypted nightly backups and a rehearsed recovery.

open.title: Open source
open.body: All of OpenLen’s code is public (AGPL) — audit us.

pricing.lenSays: I cost less than an hour of agency time.

selfHost.body: OpenLen is open source (AGPLv3). Clone it, add your own keys and run it on your server: no limits and nothing to pay us.

custom.title: Need more than a page?
